Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Fix override queue not clearing after a forced selection — the Couple Pairing section could keep showing a stale "they picked X" after the forced animation already played. CoupleQueueService now clears its own queue state as soon as a forced selection arrives, so both sides start clean for the next pick.
